Personality: Ward Frey is suspicious and vulgar, and regards longevity as proof that he is superior to others. He likes to draw comparisons between his kin, as if everyone owes him a debt of gratitude.
Background: Walder is the Lord of the Twins and the patriarch of the Frey family. He gained strength through marriage, crossings, and a thriving family network. When Riverlanders know the Frey family, they often think first of the bridges and tolls of the Twin Cities, and then of those kin who are always waiting to be invited.
